diagnostic_reproducer: Three diagnostic tests pass because each asserts unsafe behavior. This is confirmation, not expected-safe Original RED; repair lane must retain failing safe-behavior controls before implementation.

findings.label: F11-REVIEW-P1-1
findings.requirement: An elected former custodian cannot serve or issue with a superseded issuer merely because it still holds the old key.
remaining_acceptance: Expected-safe Original RED at lowest-URL former custodian; current-term authenticated authority evidence gates both reads and issuance; stale health refuses; legitimate recovery remains possible.

findings.label: F11-REVIEW-P2-1
findings.requirement: A successful nonleader relay cannot displace follower authority confirmed by the elected leader or mark consistent older relays as authority loss.
remaining_acceptance: Three-node current/older relay controls; leader confirmation and healthy admitted status survive successful rounds; genuine conflicts and replay still refuse.

findings.label: F11-REVIEW-P2-2
findings.requirement: Governance evaluators and local penalty issuance must derive trusted signers from admitted live service authority.
remaining_acceptance: Expected-safe Original RED for expired/stale follower governance; audit remaining raw production status readers; accepted path uses the same admitted status.

findings.label: F11-REVIEW-P3-1
findings.requirement: Distinguish temporarily busy authority-health inspection from verified authority loss.
remaining_acceptance: Separate health-state refinement with bounded observation freshness; no stale health success substituted for unknown authority.

findings.label: F11-REVIEW-P3-2
findings.requirement: Authenticated authority endpoints must not perform bounded but expensive signature-chain verification on async workers.
remaining_acceptance: Confirm call path, move blocking verification behind bounded cancellation-safe admission where needed, retain authentication before work and deterministic permit lifetime controls.

findings.label: F11-REVIEW-P3-3
findings.requirement: Configured authority issue-time skew and the selected owner clock must reach production opens that serve or validate replicated authority.
remaining_acceptance: Inventory startup/service/policy opens; reproduce valid configured-skew restart/read refusal; preserve expiry and owner clock-floor behavior.

findings.label: F11-REVIEW-P3-4
findings.requirement: Discovery cannot imply current admitted authority while signing with a revoked local key or nesting a separately read authority generation.
remaining_acceptance: Retired-custodian signing control, require admitted current signing custody or refuse; construct nested discovery from the same admitted status.

findings.label: F11-REVIEW-P3-5
findings.requirement: Add missing negative controls with the required authority repairs; track remaining deterministic-clock cleanup separately.
remaining_acceptance: Required lowest-URL custodian, three-node relay, governance and quorum/term-change controls accompany P1/P2 repairs. Remaining fixture clock cleanup is a separate minor follow-up if no correctness defect is found.

prior_component_evidence: The152 producer passes and test-only correction campaign remain evidence for their selected scenarios, not qualification of the new authority findings.
